title: RecipeReview
description: A household member's review of a recipe after cooking it.

rating.description: Overall verdict. 1: not for us, 2: okay, 3: cook again.

children_rating.description: What the children thought. 1: didn't eat it, 2: so-so, 3: liked it. Omitted when there are no children or no answer.

notes.description: Free-text note for next time, e.g. 'less salt'.
